Iron Ridge Brewing Co. | Asheville Taproom

Prompt

Create a bold, industrial-meets-modern homepage for "Iron Ridge Brewing Co." — an independent craft brewery with a taproom and beer garden in Asheville, NC. The design should feel artisan and confident — raw textures (concrete, wood grain, copper accents) combined with clean modern typography. Target audience: craft beer enthusiasts 25-50 and casual visitors looking for a great taproom experience.

1. NAVIGATION BAR
- Logo: "Iron Ridge Brewing Co." in a rugged condensed sans-serif with a mountain silhouette integrated above the "R" — white on dark background
- Links: Our Beers, Taproom, Tours, Events, Shop, Find Our Beer
- Right side: "Book a Tour" CTA button (solid #D97706 amber-600, dark text)
- Dark background (#1C1917 stone-900) with no border, transparent blending into hero
- Mobile: logo + hamburger + "Visit" mini CTA

2. HERO SECTION
- Full-width background: atmospheric photo of the taproom interior — warm lighting, copper brewing tanks visible through glass wall, wooden bar with taps, people enjoying flights
- Dark gradient overlay (60% bottom)
- Headline: "Brewed in the Mountains. Best at the Source." in bold uppercase, 56px, white, tight letter-spacing
- Subheadline: "Independent craft brewery & taproom in Asheville, NC — 18 beers on tap, brewery tours daily" in 18px, white/80%
- Two CTAs: "See What's On Tap" (solid #D97706) and "Book a Brewery Tour" (outline white)
- Hours badge floating in top-right corner of hero: "Open Today: 12PM–10PM" with green dot indicator

- Grid of 12 currently available beers (4x3 desktop, 2-col tablet, 1-col mobile):

  - "Blue Ridge Pils" — Czech Pilsner — 4.9% ABV — 35 IBU — "Crisp, clean, noble hops. Our best-seller since day one."
  - "Copper Line" — American Amber — 5.4% ABV — 30 IBU — "Toasty malt, caramel, balanced bitterness."
  - "Dark Hollow" — Oatmeal Stout — 5.8% ABV — 25 IBU — "Chocolate, coffee, velvet mouthfeel. Nitro pour."
  - "Trail Dust" — West Coast IPA — 7.2% ABV — 65 IBU — "Piney, resinous, old-school dank. For the hop heads."
  - "Fog Valley" — Witbier — 4.6% ABV — 15 IBU — "Orange peel, coriander, refreshing. Great gateway beer."
  - "Firebreak" — Double IPA — 8.5% ABV — 70 IBU — "Bold, tropical, dangerously smooth for 8.5%." — 🔥 fire badge for "LIMITED"
  - "Harvest Table" — Farmhouse Saison — 6.2% ABV — 22 IBU — "Peppery, dry, complex. Brewed with local wildflower honey."
  - "Stone Bridge" — Brown Ale — 5.1% ABV — 20 IBU — "Nutty, toasty, easy-drinking. A chill autumn pint."
  - "River Sour" — Berliner Weisse — 3.8% ABV — 5 IBU — "Tart, bright, kettle-soured with NC peaches." — 🍑 peach badge for "SEASONAL"
  - "Basecamp" — Golden Ale — 4.4% ABV — 18 IBU — "Light, approachable, crushable. The beer for people who don't like beer."
  - "Night Shift" — Imperial Stout — 10.2% ABV — 50 IBU — "Bourbon barrel-aged 6 months. Dark chocolate, vanilla, oak." — ⭐ star badge for "BREWERY ONLY"
- Each beer card: beer name (bold, 18px), style, ABV/IBU stats, one-line tasting note, optional badge
- Color-coded left border by style family: gold for lagers/light ales, amber for ambers/browns, dark brown for stouts/porters, green for IPAs, purple for sours/wilds
- "See Full Beer Menu (PDF)" link below

DESIGN SYSTEM
- Primary: #D97706 (amber-600) for CTAs, accents, and interactive elements
- Secondary: #1C1917 (stone-900) for dark backgrounds and headers
- Body text: #44403C (stone-700) on light backgrounds, #E7E5E4 (stone-200) on dark
- Accent: #FEF3C7 (amber-100) for badges and highlights
- Section backgrounds alternate: white, #FAFAF9 (stone-50), #292524 (stone-800)
- Typography: Oswald or Barlow Condensed for headings (uppercase, tight tracking), Inter for body text
- Textural elements: subtle grain/noise overlay on dark sections, copper/amber gradient accents on borders
- Cards: 12px border-radius, warm-toned shadows (0 2px 12px rgba(28,25,23,0.08))
- Photography: warm, amber-toned, atmospheric lighting — no sterile product shots

RESPONSIVE BEHAVIOR
- Mobile-first. Hero heading drops to 36px. Hours badge moves below CTAs.
- Tap list becomes scrollable cards, 1 per row, with swipe
- Taproom section stacks text above gallery. Gallery becomes single-image with dots to swipe
- Tour cards stack vertically
- Event cards become horizontal scroll carousel
- Beer finder map becomes full-width with location list below
- Shop products: 2x2 grid on mobile
- Footer columns collapse to accordion. All touch targets minimum 44px
